titulo_fonte: How to warm up before exercising
secao: How to warm up before exercising
texto: This warm-up routine should take at least 6 minutes. Warm up for longer if you feel the need.

titulo_fonte: How to warm up before exercising
secao: March on the spot: keep going for 3 minutes
texto:
> Figura: Marching (imagem no original HTML: https://assets.nhs.uk/nhsuk-cms/images/NHSC_0318_marching-on-spot_1_3P2A1490.original.width-320.jpg)

Start off marching on the spot and then march forwards and backwards. Pump your arms up and down in rhythm with your steps, keeping the elbows bent and the fists soft.

titulo_fonte: How to warm up before exercising
secao: Heel digs: aim for 60 heel digs in 60 seconds
texto:
> Figura: Heel digs (imagem no original HTML: https://assets.nhs.uk/nhsuk-cms/images/NHSC_0318-heel-digs_2_3P2A1498.original.width-320.jpg)

For heel digs, place alternate heels to the front, keeping the front foot pointing up, and punch out with each heel dig. Keep a slight bend in the supporting leg.

titulo_fonte: How to warm up before exercising
secao: Knee lifts: aim for 30 knee lifts in 30 seconds
texto:
> Figura: Knee lifts (imagem no original HTML: https://assets.nhs.uk/nhsuk-cms/images/NHSC_0318_knee-lifts_1_3P2A1499.original.width-320.jpg)

To do knee lifts, stand tall and bring up alternate knees to touch the opposite hand. Keep your abs tight and back straight. Keep a slight bend in the supporting leg.

titulo_fonte: How to warm up before exercising
texto:
> Figura: Shoulder rolls (imagem no original HTML: https://assets.nhs.uk/nhsuk-cms/images/NHSC_0318_shoulder-rolls_1_3P2A1512.original.width-320.jpg)

For shoulder rolls, keep marching on the spot. Roll your shoulders forwards 5 times and backwards 5 times. Let your arms hang loose by your sides.

titulo_fonte: How to warm up before exercising
texto:
> Figura: Knee bends (imagem no original HTML: https://assets.nhs.uk/nhsuk-cms/images/NHSC_0318_knee-bends_2_3P2A1515.original.width-320.jpg)

To do knee bends, stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands stretched out. Lower yourself no more than 10cm by bending your knees. Come up and repeat.

titulo_fonte: How to warm up before exercising
texto:
This aerobic warm-up video is suitable for all levels. Do this before starting on more rigorous exercise.

Media last reviewed: 8 December 2023 Media review due: 8 December 2026

See exercise video safety information

The exercises in this series of videos are suitable for most people in good health with a reasonable level of fitness.

Unless stated otherwise, they are general exercises only and are not aimed at treating any specific cause of pain or condition. Video titles and descriptions can give more information on how difficult the exercises are and who they are for.

Get advice from a healthcare professional (such as a GP) before trying them if:

- you are not sure if the exercises are suitable for your current level of fitness - you have a health problem, an injury, any symptoms, are feeling unwell, or you have had a recent health event such as a heart attack or operation - you have any other concerns about your health - you are pregnant or have recently given birth

titulo_fonte: How to warm up before exercising
texto: Stop the exercise immediately if you feel any pain or become unwell. If you are concerned about any symptoms, or they do not go away, get help from 111 online or call 111 for advice.
